I found the vacation plans document. It has a basic packing list, but I can see all the planned activities (beach, snorkeling, hiking, luau, spa, kayaking, shopping, etc.). Let me now create a comprehensive packing list based on those activities.

<function=create_file>{"filename": "hawaii-packing-list.docx", "content": "Hawaii Packing List
Emma Johnson's Vacation: June 10 - June 20, 2024

Based on the Vacation Plans Document
=====================================

CLOTHING
--------
- Swimwear (multiple sets for beach, snorkeling, kayaking)
- Cover-ups / sarongs
- Lightweight casual outfits (shorts, t-shirts, tank tops, sundresses)
- One or two smart-casual outfits for dinners and the luau
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Undergarments and socks
- Comfortable walking shoes / sandals
- Hiking shoes or sturdy sneakers (for Diamond Head hike)
- Flip-flops / beach sandals
- Hat or cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER GEAR
------------------
- Sunscreen (reef-safe, high SPF)
- After-sun lotion / aloe vera gel
- Beach towel
- Snorkeling mask and fins (if not renting)
- Waterproof phone pouch
- Dry bag (for kayaking and beach days)
- Rash guard / swim shirt

HIKING GEAR
-----------
- Hiking shoes or sturdy sneakers
- Lightweight backpack / daypack
- Reusable water bottle
- Quick-dry hiking clothes
- Insect repellent

TOILETRIES & SPA
----------------
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash / soap
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Razor and shaving cream
- Moisturizer / face cream
- Makeup (optional)
- Hairbrush / comb
- Hair ties / clips
- Lip balm with SPF

TRAVEL DOCUMENTS & ESSENTIALS
-----------------------------
- Passport or government-issued ID
- Flight tickets / boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmation
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and some cash
- Phone and charger
- Portable power bank
- Camera and charger / memory cards
- Headphones / earbuds

MISCELLANEOUS
-------------
- Snacks for the road trip to North Shore
- Reusable shopping bag (for shopping at Ala Moana Center)
- Small first-aid kit (band-aids, pain relievers, motion sickness pills)
- Books or e-reader for relaxation
- Journal and pen
- Laundry bag for dirty clothes

Notes:
- Most snorkeling and kayaking equipment can be rented locally if preferred.
- Check weather forecast closer to departure for any adjustments.
- Don't forget to pack light — leave room for souvenirs!
"}
